Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE full-body Mira chibi map character sprite on a genuinely transparent alpha background, 1024x1024 square. Image 1 is the sole authority for Mira's identity, face, hair, costume and staff. Ignore all text. Image 2 is ONLY a rendering style and chibi proportions reference, especially its first two top-row characters (elf archer and brown-haired swordsman). Do not copy the old hooded healer costume in image 2.
Character: Mira, gentle mature quiet healer, long pale lavender hair with delicate side braid and loose flowing lengths, soft grey-lavender eyes and faintly tired compassionate smile. Her head is UNCOVERED, no hood or hat. Hair ornament exactly from image1: small white flowers, crescent moon, muted blue-lavender ribbons. Translate image1 outfit faithfully into compact chibi: white lightweight open-shoulder healing robe with voluminous detached sleeves, short layered white dress, long asymmetrical white robe tails lined pale lavender/blue, delicate gold floral/moon motifs and edging, dark brown waist belt and medical pouches with little vial and crescent charm. White/pale-lavender ankle footwear with brown/gold trim. Hold image1 healing staff: slender dark shaft, round pale luminous crystal embraced by a gold crescent, white flowers and blue-lavender ribbons near top. Entire staff including top and lower tip fits in canvas.
Proportions: about THREE heads tall matching first two map sprites in image2, compact stylized anime game chibi, mature gentle demeanor preserved rather than baby-like. Rich clean hand-painted fantasy RPG sprite shading with crisp dark contour and beautiful small details readable at map scale, consistent with image2. Calm balanced standing pose, body and face three-quarter toward viewer's RIGHT, feet planted slightly apart, staff held naturally upright on her right side, relaxed free hand. Pose can bob gently for walking or support animation. One coherent silhouette, all hair, staff, robe tails and feet fully inside frame, compact transparent margin. Center character-plus-staff group. No background, no ground plane or ground shadow, no glow cloud outside staff crystal, no text, no UI, no labels, no sheet, no extra characters.
